title: Connect restaurant domain
subtitle: Serve your restaurant menu on a domain you own with automatic SSL.
dnsHelp: Add the appropriate record at your domain provider, wait for DNS propagation, then select Verify.
apex: For an apex domain, use an A record named @ with value 76.76.21.21.
subdomain: For a subdomain such as menu, use a CNAME record with value cname.vercel-dns-0.com.
notConfigured: Vercel API environment variables must be configured in production before connecting a domain.
added: The domain was added. Configure DNS, then select Verify.
verifiedSuccess: The domain is verified and ready.
invalid: Enter a valid domain without https or paths.
unavailable: The domain is already used or could not be added to the Vercel project.
removeFirst: Remove the current domain before adding another one.
upgrade: Custom domains are available on the Business plan.
confirmRemove: Remove this domain from the restaurant and Vercel project?
